title: AWS Cloud Migration Architect
description:
**What awaits you/ Job Profile**

  



* Assess current on\-premises infrastructure, applications, databases, and dependencies.
* Develop migration roadmaps, wave plans, and modernization strategies.
* Design secure, scalable, highly available AWS architectures.
* Migrate Linux and Windows workloads from on\-premises data centers to AWS.
* Migrate NAS\-based storage solutions to AWS storage services.
* Implement disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.
* Configure load balancing, autoscaling, monitoring, and security controls.
* Enable encryption in transit and at rest.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise governance and security standards.

  

**What should you bring along**

**Must Have**


* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS migration projects.
* Expertise in Amazon EC2, VPC, ALB/NLB, EFS, S3, Backup, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, CI/CD Pipelines.
* NAS Storage, AWS EFS and FSx, TCP/IP Networking, DNS, Load Balancing, Reverse Proxies.
* Java/J2EE, Spring Framework / Spring Boot, Angular, REST APIs
* Apache HTTP Server, GlassFish Application Server
* Oracle Database, Linux and Windows Server
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands\-on experience with Terraform and AWS CloudFormation for automated, repeatable infrastructure provisioning.
* Container \& Modernization Experience: Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, and application modernization strategies such as rehosting, replatforming, and refactoring.
* Experience with AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), AWS Migration Hub, Cloud Endure, AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), and migration assessment/discovery tools.
* Understanding incident management, change management and problem management and ITIL support processes at enterprise level.
* Excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills.
* Ability to deal with uncertainty and a volatile environment with ambiguous and conflicting requirements and priorities.
* Ability to operate in an intercultural environment (international platform).
* Ability to work as part of a team, interdependent as well as independently and complete deliverables on time.

  

**Must have technical skill**

  



AWS Migration Specialty (preferred)

title: Technical Manager - SOC
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead Cybersecurity Engineer to lead the design, engineering, deployment, optimization, and ongoing improvement of enterprise security controls and platforms. The role requires strong hands\-on expertise across EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, Microsoft 365 Security, identity security, vulnerability management, and security automation. The successful candidate will drive technical implementation initiatives, strengthen detection and response capabilities, support SOC operations, and ensure security controls align with organizational strategy, risk posture, and compliance requirements.

  

  

Key Responsibilities :


* Lead the design, engineering, deployment, and continuous improvement of enterprise security tools and platforms, including EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, and Microsoft 365 security solutions.
* Architect and implement scalable security controls to protect endpoints, networks, cloud workloads, identity systems, and business\-critical infrastructure.
* Manage and optimize integrations across security platforms, including EDR, SIEM, SOAR, MDM, IAM, and related monitoring tools.
* Drive incident detection and response engineering through alert tuning, detection use case development, correlation logic, and automation playbooks.
* Oversee deployment and enforcement of endpoint security controls, including DLP, USB/device control, device compliance policies, and endpoint hardening standards.
* Collaborate with SOC, Infrastructure, IAM, Cloud, and application teams to ensure security controls are implemented, monitored, and operationalized effectively.
* Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for security events, tool failures, policy issues, log ingestion gaps, and control effectiveness concerns.
* Establish and maintain SIEM use cases, correlation rules, dashboards, reports, and operational metrics to improve monitoring and executive visibility.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, validate scan results, support remediation planning, and track risk reduction activities through closure.
* Participate in change management processes to assess security impact, define control requirements, and ensure security tooling remains aligned with approved changes.
* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell, Python, SOAR workflows, and other scripting methods to reduce manual effort and improve response consistency.
* Develop and maintain security baselines, hardening standards, deployment playbooks, operational guides, and technical documentation.
* Monitor emerging threats, threat intelligence, and adversary techniques to adapt detections and controls based on current attack trends.
* Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentorship to junior engineers, SOC analysts, and cross\-functional teams.
  

  

Technical Responsibilities


* Engineer, deploy, and administer EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, including policy tuning, threat detection, response actions, and control validation.
* Implement and manage SIEM platforms such as CrowdStrike NG SIEM or Splunk, including log onboarding, parsing, normalization, dashboarding, and advanced correlation logic.
* Design, implement, and support IDS/IPS and network security monitoring solutions to improve threat visibility, prevention, and investigation capability.
* Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 Security capabilities, including Microsoft Defender Suite, Entra ID, Conditional Access, Secure Score improvements, and identity protection controls.
* Manage MDM platforms such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent solutions for device compliance, device posture, policy enforcement, and access control.
* Implement of identity security controls, including MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access controls, least privilege, and Zero Trust principles.
* Build and maintain SOC automation and SOAR workflows for incident triage, evidence collection, containment actions, enrichment, notification, and reporting.
* Integrate and manage threat intelligence feeds across security tools to support proactive detection, enrichment, and threat hunting.
* Perform log source integration across servers, endpoints, network devices, cloud platforms, firewalls, identity systems, and business\-critical applications.
* Support compliance and audit activities, including HIPAA, NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS\-aligned evidence gathering, configuration review, reporting, and technical control validation.
  

  

Required Skills and Experience


* Strong hands\-on experience in security engineering, control implementation, and enterprise security tool deployment.
* Proven expertise in incident detection, incident response, alert tuning, threat hunting, and SOC enablement.
* Experience with firewalls, endpoint protection, cloud security controls, identity controls, and Microsoft security ecosystems.
* Working knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex multi\-layer security issues across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and application environments.
* Strong understanding of modern attack techniques, adversary behaviors, MITRE ATT\&CK framework, and detection engineering principles.
* Experience working in fast\-paced SOC, security engineering, or enterprise security operations environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, technical leadership, prioritization, and project execution skills.
  

  

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in IT Security, including at least 5\+ years in security engineering, implementation, or platform administration roles.
* Hands\-on experience with EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, Microsoft 365 Security, IAM/PAM, vulnerability management, and cloud security controls.
* Strong understanding of security frameworks and benchmarks, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and CIS Benchmarks.

title: Technical Specialist – Salesforce Revenue Cloud
description:
**Are you an experienced Salesforce professional looking to build your expertise in Salesforce Revenue Cloud and enterprise Quote\-to\-Cash transformation?**


Join **LevelShift as a Technical Specialist Salesforce Revenue Cloud,** where you'll be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions. You'll work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, developers, integration teams, QA, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and deliver enterprise\-grade Quote\-to\-Cash capability.

  

  

**What You'll Do**


**As a Technical Specialist Salesforce Revenue Cloud at LevelShift, you will:**


* Develop and customize Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA) solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Salesforce Platform technologies.
* Configure and enhance Product Catalogs, Pricing, Quoting, and Revenue Cloud capabilities to support end\-to\-end Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C) business processes.
* Design and implement scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce best practices, security standards, and enterprise architecture.
* Develop Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and custom Salesforce functionality based on business and technical requirements.
* Design and develop integrations between Salesforce, ERP systems, middleware, and third\-party applications using REST APIs and modern integration frameworks.
* Support data migration activities, including data mapping, transformation, validation, loading, reconciliation, and data quality.
* Participate in solution design, technical estimation, development, testing, deployment, and release management activities.
* Work with solution architects and functional consultants to translate Revenue Cloud and Quote\-to\-Cash requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to Salesforce coding standards, security best practices, integration patterns, and development guidelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to Revenue Cloud, Apex, LWC, integrations, data, configurations, and Salesforce platform functionality.
* Support SIT, UAT, deployment, production support, defect management, and technical issue resolution throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare and maintain technical design documents, data mappings, integration specifications, deployment documents, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with QA teams to develop test scenarios, support defect resolution, and ensure solution quality.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and provide effective technical solutions.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve Revenue Cloud processes, automation, system performance, scalability, and overall solution quality**.**
  

  

**How This Role Uses AI**


* Should be comfortable using AI tools to enhance Salesforce development, solution design, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and engineering productivity while ensuring responsible AI usage.
* Utilize AI\-assisted development for Apex, LWC, Salesforce Flows, integrations, debugging, technical documentation, code reviews, and test\-case generation.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools such as Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein AI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and improve solution delivery.
* Explore opportunities to use AI for Quote\-to\-Cash automation, business process optimization, data analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and developer productivity.
* Ensure AI\-assisted development follows appropriate data privacy, security, governance, and Salesforce development standards.
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve existing Revenue Cloud development, testing, support, monitoring, and technical workflows.
  

  

**Your Skillset**


* 57 years of experience in Salesforce development, implementation, technical consulting, or solution delivery, with strong hands\-on experience in Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA).
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, and Salesforce Platform.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Product Catalog, Pricing, Quoting, and Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C) processes.
* Experience implementing and configuring Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA) capabilities for enterprise business requirements.
* Strong experience developing custom Apex classes, triggers, LWC components, Flows, and Salesforce customizations.
* Experience designing and implementing REST API integrations between Salesforce and external applications.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP systems, middleware, and third\-party applications.
* Good understanding of data migration, data transformation, data validation, and Salesforce data management.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, sharing, profiles, permission sets, governor limits, platform limitations, and development best practices.
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps, version control, deployment processes, testing frameworks, and release management.
* Experience performing code reviews, technical troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, deployment, production support, defect management, and release activities.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with architects, functional consultants, QA teams, integration teams, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver scalable solutions within project timelines.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Salesforce platform innovations, AI, integrations, and emerging Salesforce technologies.
  

  

**Why LevelShift?**


* Accelerate your career by working on enterprise\-scale Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Quote\-to\-Cash transformation initiatives for global customers.
* Gain hands\-on exposure to the latest Salesforce innovations, including Revenue Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein AI, and AI\-assisted development.
* Work with experienced Salesforce architects, consultants, developers, and technology leaders in a collaborative environment.
* Gain experience across challenging Revenue Cloud implementations, integrations, data migration, and enterprise application development.
* Build strong technical and consulting capabilities through continuous learning, certification support, technical mentoring, and challenging implementation projects.
* Be part of a culture that values innovation, technical excellence, ownership, collaboration, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, professional development programs, Salesforce certification support, and exposure to emerging Salesforce and AI technologies.
